title: Hynek delivers a prepared computer to Benowitz

tellings.quote: J. Alan Heinik showed up at Paul's door with a computer, an entirely built alreadymade computer and said, "This will help you with the signals

plain: Around 1980, the astronomer J. Allen Hynek is said to have turned up at the door of Paul Benowitz, a man in Albuquerque, New Mexico, who was picking up signals he thought were alien, with a fully built computer and the words, "This will help you with the signals." A writer named Greg Bishop tells this from what a UFO researcher named Bill Moore told him. If true, it would mean a well-known scientist was quietly helping, or steering, Benowitz's work.
